Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 153. Category: stance. Stances.

Prerequisites: Wisdom 15+
The defensive and thoughtful style of Majunior, the
son of the Demon King Piccolo.
You may take the dodge action as a bonus action.
all beam and barrage techniques have +50% range
You may add half of your proficiency bonus to
concentration checks.
